name: ChatGPT Agent
knownFor: OpenAI’s agent features in ChatGPT (including longer task running and related “Dot” / agent modes on higher plans).
popCaption: Editorial estimate, with distribution through ChatGPT (55.7% of seven-assistant website visits in October 2026, Similarweb — not an agent-only figure) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Comes with the most-visited assistant in the Similarweb set
con: Feature names and limits change by plan; this is not a standalone automation platform
costCaption: Sold as part of ChatGPT paid plans. Rated on ChatGPT Plus at $20/month (OpenAI Help, checked Nov 2026). OpenAI Help and chatgpt.com/pricing also describe agent features and higher limits on Pro tiers ($100–$500/month). Confirm which agent features your plan includes.

name: Claude Computer Use
knownFor: Claude’s computer-use and cowork-style agents, which can operate a desktop or take longer hand-off tasks, included with paid Claude plans.
popCaption: Editorial estimate, tied to Claude’s 11.5% share of seven-assistant website visits in October 2026 (Similarweb — not a computer-use-specific figure) · checked Nov 2026
learn: Letting Claude operate a computer or a long task
pro: Bundled with a clearly priced Claude plan
con: Usage is shared with the rest of the plan and can run out on long tasks
costCaption: Included with paid Claude plans. Official claude.com/pricing (checked Nov 2026) lists Pro at $20/month ($17/month billed annually) and describes hand-off / scheduled tasks; Max is $100/month and Ultra is $200/month. Rated on Pro.

name: Zapier
knownFor: A no-code automation platform, now with AI and agent features, used to connect apps and run workflows.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. Zapier is the most widely known general automation platform in this set; no public workflow-count was found.
pro: A clear official individual price and the default name in this category
con: Task limits and higher agent add-ons can raise the real bill
costCaption: Official zapier.com/pricing (checked Nov 2026): Free; Professional starting from $19.99/month; Team starting from $69/month. Separate Agents Pro is listed at $33.33/month when billed annually ($400/year). Rated on Professional, the typical individual paid platform plan.

name: Make
knownFor: A visual automation platform (formerly Integromat) for building multi-step scenarios between apps.
pro: A well-known Zapier alternative with a scenario-based editor
con: Official price was not captured this session
costCaption: Make sells free and paid individual plans. This session did not capture a current official individual monthly figure from make.com/pricing. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical individual paid plan. Confirm current prices on make.com/pricing.

name: n8n
knownFor: An open-source workflow and agent platform you can self-host or run as n8n Cloud.
popCaption: 210,503 GitHub stars on n8n-io/n8n (GitHub API, checked Nov 14, 2026). Stars measure interest in the open project, not Cloud seats.
learn: Self-hosted or Cloud workflows you can inspect
pro: A huge open-source footprint plus a published Cloud price
con: Cloud is priced in euros; self-hosting shifts cost to your own servers
costCaption: Official n8n.io/pricing (checked Nov 2026): Cloud Starter 20€/month billed annually; Cloud Pro 50€/month billed annually; Business 667€/month billed annually. A self-hosted Community edition is also offered. Rated on Starter (20€/month billed annually), the cheapest official Cloud plan. Band $$ is based on that published euro price, not a converted US-dollar figure.

name: Lindy
knownFor: A consumer and business agent product for email, scheduling, and other office tasks.
learn: An assistant that does office tasks
pro: Aimed at real-world admin work, not only chat
con: Official price was not captured this session
costCaption: Lindy sells individual and team plans. This session did not capture a current official monthly figure. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical individual plan. Confirm current prices on lindy.ai.

name: Manus
knownFor: A general-purpose AI agent product aimed at longer, multi-step tasks in a browser-based workspace.
pro: A dedicated agent product rather than a chatbot mode
con: Official price was not captured this session
costCaption: Manus sells paid plans. This session did not capture a current official individual monthly figure. Editorial estimate $$$ for a typical individual plan. Confirm current prices on the official Manus site.

name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
knownFor: Microsoft’s tool for building custom copilots and agents, aimed at Microsoft 365 and Power Platform shops.
popCaption: Editorial estimate, based on Microsoft 365 distribution rather than a public Studio seat-count · checked Nov 2026
learn: Custom agents inside a Microsoft shop
pro: Fits organizations already standardized on Microsoft 365
con: Not a typical individual plan; the cost band is an editorial estimate
costCaption: Copilot Studio is sold as a Microsoft business / Power Platform product, often quote- or capacity-based rather than a simple individual monthly plan. Editorial estimate $$$$ (no clean individual monthly seat was captured this session). Confirm current prices on microsoft.com.

name: Google Antigravity
knownFor: Google’s agent-and-coding surface described on official Google AI plans, aimed at longer agent requests and developer work.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. Official Google AI plan pages list Antigravity as a feature, not a standalone traffic-ranked product.
pro: Published as part of official Google AI pricing
con: Still a plan feature more than a standalone household-name product
costCaption: Listed on official Google AI plans (one.google.com/about/google-ai-plans, checked Nov 2026) with agent-request limits that rise from Plus at $4.99/month through Pro at $19.99/month to Ultra at $99.99 or $199.99/month. Rated on Google AI Pro at $19.99/month as a typical individual paid path.

name: Relevance AI
knownFor: A platform for building and running teams of AI agents, aimed at business workflows.
learn: A business platform for teams of agents
pro: Aimed at building agents, not only running one assistant
con: Official price was not captured this session
costCaption: Relevance AI sells paid platform plans. This session did not capture a current official individual monthly figure. Editorial estimate $$$ for a typical paid plan. Confirm current prices on relevanceai.com/pricing.
